app.name: ftpii BR
app.long_description:
Versao modificada do ftpii 0.0.22 (Joseph Jordan, GPLv2). / Modified version of ftpii 0.0.22.
- Tela em portugues e ingles / Portuguese and English screen - SD e HD USB montados sozinhos / SD and USB drive mounted automatically - Conexoes paradas sao liberadas, sem travar / idle connections are freed, no more lockups - NAND somente leitura / NAND read-only
Senha / Password: renomeie a pasta para apps/ftpiibr_SuaSenha / rename the folder to apps/ftpiibr_YourPassword. A ou HOME: sair / exit. B: remontar SD e USB / remount SD and USB.
